title: LgWSC Districts Served Directory
content: Lukanga Water Supply and Sanitation Company (LgWSC) serves 12 districts in the Central Province of Zambia, which include: Kabwe, Kapiri Mposhi, Mkushi, Serenje, Mumbwa, Chibombo, Chisamba, Shibuyunji, Itezhi-Tezhi, Chitambo, Luano, and Ngabwe.
